Target-minimum surjectivity is precisely coverage of every target cycle edge. Matrix traces count closed walks on allowed edge subsets; inclusion-exclusion enforces all-edge coverage. Lifted increments classify nonzero windings and show any zero-winding edge-covering length is >=2m; at 2m there are 2m*m such walks. For m=2 the two target minima with identical upper pair give 2 choices at each binary transition; even-binomial summation gives the separate formula. Fresh brute enumeration independently checked seven small actual bounded-morphism cases including n=m=2 and compared m>=3 to edge-surjective walks. Critical limits: source and target n,m>=2, indexed actual functions, all reflexive posets; finite enumeration is not the all-parameter argument.
